definition: Partial fills share an engine position ID; sum complete two-leg lifetime PnL, all executed entry/exit fees and realized funding. Unfilled signals are not trades.
hypothesis: H0: mean completed-trade net PnL <= 0; H1: mean > 0

summary.strategy: passive perp basis entry, immediate equal-BTC spot hedge
summary.exit_execution: Opposite entry threshold closes both legs to flat at taker prices; that signal episode cannot reopen; any enabled funding exits remain active
summary.capacity_rule: One signed order-sized basis position; no opposite entries until flat
summary.funding_assumption: Recorded settlement cash flows on held positions
summary.funding_signal: Causal weighted average of completed 1m premium-index CLOSE proxies; not exact exchange forecast
summary.limitations: Open positions marked at mids; closed pairs use both executable exit sides and all four leg fees. Spot price-only input uses last-trade proxy with assumed spread. Borrow availability, interest, impact, depth, margin and liquidation are not modeled. No queue reconstruction. Midpoint convergence does not guarantee a positive executable round trip.

exit_day_cluster.note: All calendar exit-day clusters, including zero-event days; t reference with G-1 df.

exit_day_hac_7.note: Bartlett weights through seven calendar-day lags on exit-day cluster scores; asymptotic normal reference.

incomplete_position_policy: Open positions at the archive end are excluded from the completed-trade test; their marked contribution remains in the portfolio result. No daily or terminal forced exits were added.
inference_note: Nonoverlapping trades are not necessarily independent. The requested ordinary t-test is an in-sample diagnostic; exit-day clustering/HAC only address some market dependence. Lifetime PnL per trade is not PnL per day or a fixed-capital return.
